/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -B -c 'from solution import reconcile; from copy import deepcopy

def e(v,p=None,**kw): return dict(entity=\"a\",version=v,payload=p,**kw)
cases=[([],{}),([e(2,\"first\"),e(2,\"last\")],{\"a\":\"last\"}),([e(3,\"new\"),e(1,deleted=True)],{\"a\":\"new\"}),([e(3,deleted=True),e(1,\"old\")],{}),([e(3,deleted=True),e(4,\"revived\")],{\"a\":\"revived\"}),([e(3,\"live\"),e(3,deleted=True)],{}),([e(3,deleted=True),e(3,\"live\")],{\"a\":\"live\"}),([{\"entity\":\" \",\"version\":0,\"payload\":False},{\"entity\":\"A\",\"version\":0,\"payload\":None},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":0,\"payload\":0}],{\" \":False,\"A\":None,\"a\":0}),([{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":0,\"deleted\":True}],{})]
for events,expected in cases: assert reconcile(iter(events))==expected
invalid=[None,[],1,{}, {\"entity\":\"a\"},{\"version\":0,\"payload\":1}]
invalid += [dict(entity=x,version=0,payload=1) for x in (\"\",None,0,False,[])]
invalid += [dict(entity=\"a\",version=x,payload=1) for x in (-1,True,False,1.0,\"1\",None)]
invalid += [dict(entity=\"a\",version=0,payload=1,deleted=x) for x in (None,0,1,\"\",[])]
invalid += [{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":0}]
for bad in invalid:
 for prefix in ([],[e(100,\"winner\")]):
  try: reconcile(iter(prefix+[bad]))
  except ValueError: pass
  else: raise AssertionError((\"accepted invalid\",bad))
events=[e(1,{\"nested\":[{\"x\":1}]}),{\"entity\":\"b\",\"version\":0,\"payload\":[],\"extra\":True}]
before=deepcopy(events); result=reconcile(iter(events)); assert events==before
assert result[\"a\"] is not events[0][\"payload\"]
result[\"a\"][\"nested\"][0][\"x\"]=2; assert events==before
events[0][\"payload\"][\"nested\"].append(3); assert result[\"a\"][\"nested\"]==[{\"x\":2}]
class OnePass:
 def __init__(self): self.used=False
 def __iter__(self):
  assert not self.used
  self.used=True
  yield e(0,None)
assert reconcile(OnePass())=={\"a\":None}
cyclic=[]; cyclic.append(cyclic); out=reconcile([e(0,cyclic)])[\"a\"]; assert out is not cyclic and out[0] is out
print(\"PASS: 9 ordering/value cases;\",len(invalid),\"invalid events tested fresh and stale; isolation, input preservation, one-pass, cyclic payload\")'"
